description: Third-party service providers do not support customers' PCI compliance.
applicability: This signal applies to: Organizations processing, storing, or transmitting cardholder data Security and compliance teams Human resources and training departments Third-party service providers (TPSPs) Incident response teams

related_controls: 12.9 - Third-party service providers (TPSPs) support their customers' PCI DSS compliance
metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: For service providers, verify written acknowledgments to customers regarding data security responsibilities, documentation of services provided, and evidence of PCI DSS compliance status communication. Monitor for customer-facing compliance documentation and support processes.
